title: Quantum Key Bloom
tagline: Compare four post-quantum key encapsulation decapsulation pathways by their scaling cost under adversarial load.

curves.label: Kyber-Like Decapsulation

curves.label: Classic RSA CRT
curves.code: const m1 = modPow(c, dP, p); const m2 = modPow(c, dQ, q); let h = (m1-m2)*qInv % p; if (h<0) h+=p; return m2 + h*q;
